title: Secondary-viewport swapchain transition uses srcStage TOP_OF_PIPE, not the acquire semaphore's wait stage
expected_finding: ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderWindow's UNDEFINED -> COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL barrier on the acquired backbuffer has srcStage TOP_OF_PIPE, while the submit waits on ImageAcquiredSemaphore only at COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT; the layout transition is not ordered after the semaphore wait, so it races the presentation engine's read (write-after-read)
